text: Mercari, Inc. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 4385). Its corporate governance report of 1 October 2025 lists its major shareholders as founder and CEO Shintaro Yamada (22.08%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 17.88%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 6.16%) and suadd K.K. (5.68%), and records no controlling shareholder and no parent company.
short: Mercari is listed on TSE Prime; founder-CEO Shintaro Yamada is the largest holder with 22.08%, and no controlling shareholder is recorded.
